software.name: SAS
software.description: The author supplied SAS code but no version. The existing environment probe attempted the documented SAS 9.4 TS1M8 command and failed to initialize TKELS; its own note says entitlement cannot be inferred. Runtime capability for the program’s pipe-delimited and CSV PROC IMPORT reads and Stata-format PROC EXPORT output, including the readability of the resulting AL2018.dta, remains unverified.

issues.description: The entry program uses a Windows C: library root and absolute C: paths for raw imports, the winsor include, and the Stata export. This Linux SAS environment needs one coherent local root/configuration across every producer and consumer, including the india library tables.

The active include [redacted-path-132782fd308b] and its %winsor macro definition are absent from the supplied package. Both calls are required before final sample export; their exact implementation cannot be supplied from this release.

The supplied SAS file constructs and exports an analysis dataset but contains no estimation or table-generation program. The workbook is only a firm-key list, not a prepared analysis dataset. The supplied builder filters to fiscal years 1991–2004 and assigns actual DRT dates; Appendix Table AIII instead uses 1998–2010 with hypothetical DRT shifted seven years, and no alternate preparation branch is supplied. Appendix Table AI documents Prowess daily BSE returns annualized by firm-year with at least 150 trading days, but the supplied SAS builder does not consume returns; this remains a candidate input lead for the absent downstream analysis program, with current product compatibility unverified. Obtain the companion analysis code and its required inputs before claiming paper-level reproduction.

For the internet-appendix bank-count comparison, supplied SAS selects fyear=DRT_1styear+1, while Appendix Table AVIII describes measuring change through two years after implementation. The intended post year and matching bank-history coverage are unresolved.

actions.description: Configure the Windows-rooted SAS paths as one consistent local data/output root before attempting the author program.
steps: Select a writable local root for the author data tree and its india SAS library.

Map the [redacted-path-000b6ae25a3a] library root and the [redacted-path-7479df7c77d8] locations consistently across source lines 17, 24, 33, 42, 254, 279, 301, 508, 841 and 1099; preserve the same root for india.TLR0516 creation/readback and all india.* tables.
Place each verified author input and the winsor macro at its mapped location; keep the final AL2018.dta output under the configured output root.
validation: Statically confirm every C: path resolves under the same configured root and each india.* producer/consumer shares the same library.
After runtime and inputs are separately verified, inspect SAS logs for successful reads, TLR0516 write/read, macro calls, and final export.

actions.description: Resolve access to the Prowess exports consumed by the supplied author sample builder. CMIE currently describes a subscription product with downloadable text financial data, but current field/vintage compatibility is unverified.
steps: Confirm an authorized Prowess route and whether the author-era exports or compatible versions are available; do not treat the catalog miss as a license decision.

Obtain the separate pipe-delimited exports financials0521.txt, lineitems0808.txt, borrowings061517.txt, and identity0427.txt, preserving their company/date keys and the source fields used throughout the SAS construction; obtain the field map and exact vintage from the authors if needed.
Confirm financial history covers at least 1989–2004: final rows are 1991–2004, while the one-year lag of change_pat is itself built from a one-year-lagged accounting change.
Obtain bankers.txt as a distinct bank-history input with bnkhist_cocode, bnkhist_date and banker_name; confirm source, exact date encoding and treatment-year endpoint.
validation: Check the three financial files each contain sa_finance1_cocode and sa_finance1_year and that their field mapping supplies every downstream variable consumed by the program.
Confirm identity keys/attributes match the financial company codes and that required historical observations exist without inferring completeness from the current product page.
For bankers.txt, verify company/date/banker keys match the financial date encoding and the author-confirmed comparison horizon.

Verify that the exported AL2018.dta is readable by the intended downstream reader and exposes the expected prepared-data fields; perform no SAS retry or author-program execution during this assessment.

actions.description: Request the missing author analysis driver(s) and any analysis-only prepared data routes needed to reproduce the main-paper and appendix tables.
steps: Request the Stata or other downstream regression program(s) for the exported AL2018.dta and a table-to-script/input map for the main paper and every appendix result.

For Table AI, retain the appendix as the source for a Prowess daily BSE return candidate: the downstream script must annualize firm-year returns and apply the stated 150-trading-day minimum. CMIE currently lists daily returns for listed firms, but exact BSE fields, historical coverage and compatibility remain unverified; request the authors’ actual route and mapping with the missing program.

Request the code and any specifically documented inputs for Table AII and Table AIII; Table AIII requires a 1998–2010 placebo sample with hypothetical DRT shifted seven years, which is absent from the supplied 1991–2004 actual-DRT builder.
Do not create an analysis_only scope until a supplied analysis entry point and compatible author-prepared analysis data route are identified.
validation: Verify the supplied analysis scripts point to the output actually produced by this SAS program, identify all additional inputs and table-specific routes, and cover the documented outputs without changing samples or estimators.
For Table AI, verify the author-documented BSE daily-return field mapping, annualization, 150 valid trading days per retained firm-year and relevant period before estimating.
For Table AIII, verify a separate supported placebo construction produces the documented 1998–2010 sample and seven-year treatment shift.

actions.description: Clarify the appendix AVIII bank-count horizon before changing the bank-history construction.
steps: Ask whether the intended post period is DRT_1styear+1 as coded or two years after implementation as described in Appendix Table AVIII.
Request the corresponding bank-history endpoint and any corrected author source if the code or appendix description is stale.
validation: Confirm the final pre/post-year selection and resulting bank counts match the author-confirmed definition and Table AVIII sample before estimating the appendix result.

review_notes: The complete package variant is sample-construction code plus a firm-identifier workbook, not a supplied regression package. The workbook probe reads one key column in one row and does not establish full analysis data or a bypass route.

The SAS file writes TLR0516 and reads it back under the same india library; D0007 is generated by the supplied producer, while the separate india.* tables and [redacted-path-b70c89c5c662] remain distinct external inputs.

The final code panel is fiscal years 1991–2004. Main financial lags require preceding-year data; lchange_pat lags a change measure that already uses lagged accounting values, so Table AII’s early panel needs raw financial history through 1989. The exact Prowess vintage/field mapping is unresolved.

All 16 frozen dependency IDs are covered. Catalog lookups included author aliases and the documented Prowess/CMIE, RBI and Government PIN source families; no matches are metadata only and do not establish absent data or licenses.

The SAS comments identify bankers.txt, dist_bank, state_con and bsize as appendix-only inputs; they remain in scope because the supplied entry point runs them and exports the combined dataset. Table AIII’s requested 1998–2010 hypothetical-DTR preparation is not present in the 1991–2004 actual-DTR builder.

Appendix AI’s Prowess daily-return and 150-trading-day specification is retained only as an unverified input lead for the missing downstream analysis driver; it is not a mandatory input to the supplied SAS builder. No independent analysis reconstruction is proposed.
